title: 3D Surface Plotter
description: Interactive 3D surface plotter for z = f(x, y) with presets, domain controls, colorscales and contour lines.

title: EM Vector Calculus
description: Six-part vector calculus lab: cheat sheet, point vs vector, projections, line integrals, surfaces & volume, triple integrals.

title: Maxwell 3D
description: Interactive 3D Maxwell's equations explorer with charge, capacitor, dipole and solenoid presets.

title: EMFCraft
description: Interactive 3D laboratory for classical electromagnetics: curl/divergence visualizers, Gaussian surfaces, Amperian loops, and Maxwell's equations.

title: EM-Kraus-LAB
description: Interactive laboratory with multiple choice for classical electromagnetics.

title: EM-TRANSMISSION-LINES
description: Interactive 3D electromagnetics lab for transmission lines—covering distributed RLCG models, TEM fields, VSWR, Smith charts, stub matching, quarter-wave transformers, and TDR transients from Kraus & Fleisch Chapter 3.

title: EM-WAVE-PROPAGATION
description: propagation of waves through space and media, their polarization, reflection, refraction, and diffraction

title: EM-ANTENNAS-CH5
description: Chapter 5 explores the physics of electromagnetic radiation and antenna engineering, covering fundamental radiation parameters, wire and aperture antenna architectures, and phased-array beam steering.

title: EM-ELECTRODYNAMICS-CH6
description: Chapter 6 of Kraus and Fleisch's Electromagnetics with Applications covers time-varying electromagnetic fields, Maxwell's equations, and plane-wave propagation, polarization, reflection, and power flow (the Poynting vector) across free space, dielectrics, and conductors.

title: EM-DIELECTRICS-MAGNETICS-CH7
description: Chapter 7 of Kraus and Fleisch's Electromagnetics with Applications examines how dielectric and magnetic materials respond to electric and magnetic fields—covering polarization, permittivity, dielectric breakdown, magnetic dipole moments, magnetization, hysteresis, boundary conditions, and stored field energy.

title: EM-WAVEGUIDES-RESONATORS-FIBER-CH8
description: Chapter 8 of Kraus and Fleisch's Electromagnetics with Applications explains how electromagnetic waves are confined and guided through hollow metallic waveguides, surface-wave structures, dielectric slabs, and optical fibers—covering TE/TM cutoff modes, dispersion, waveguide devices, and resonant cavities.

title: bioelectromagnetics
description: Interactive 3D simulations exploring how electric and magnetic fields interact with living tissue—from nerve axon transmission lines, retinal waveguides, and cardiac dipole fields to defibrillator pulses, biomagnetic sensing, and RF SAR safety limits.

title: em-high-speed-digital-systems
description: Interactive 3D and 2D simulations exploring electromagnetic wave propagation on high-speed circuit boards—covering lumped versus distributed circuit thresholds, signal rise time and knee frequency, transmission line reflections, capacitive loading, impedance terminations, PCB stack-ups, crosstalk, and EMI shielding.
